// Generate SQL based on analysis type
const input = $input.first().json;
const analysisType = input.analysis_type;
const stationId = input.station_id;
const years = input.years;
const stationName = input.station_name;

if (!stationId) {
  return [{ json: { error: 'No station specified', query: null } }];
}

let query = '';

// Analysis 1: Monthly Probability
if (analysisType === 'monthly_probability') {
  query = `
WITH monthly_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM measurement_date)::int as mes,
    water_level_m,
    water_level_cm
  FROM water_level_measurements 
  WHERE station_id = '${stationId}'
    AND parameter = 'NivelMedioDiario'
    AND measurement_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '${years} years'
),
percentiles AS (
  SELECT 
    mes,
    COUNT(*) as registros,
    ROUND(AVG(water_level_m)::numeric, 3) as promedio_m,
    ROUND(AVG(water_level_cm)::numeric, 1) as promedio_cm,
    ROUND(MIN(water_level_m)::numeric, 3) as minimo_m,
    ROUND(MAX(water_level_m)::numeric, 3) as maximo_m,
    ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.10) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY water_level_m)::numeric, 3) as p10_m,
    ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY water_level_m)::numeric, 3) as p25_m,
    ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.50) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY water_level_m)::numeric, 3) as p50_m,
    ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY water_level_m)::numeric, 3) as p75_m,
    ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.90) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY water_level_m)::numeric, 3) as p90_m
  FROM monthly_stats
  GROUP BY mes
)
SELECT 
  mes,
  CASE mes
    WHEN 1 THEN 'Enero' WHEN 2 THEN 'Febrero' WHEN 3 THEN 'Marzo'
    WHEN 4 THEN 'Abril' WHEN 5 THEN 'Mayo' WHEN 6 THEN 'Junio'
    WHEN 7 THEN 'Julio' WHEN 8 THEN 'Agosto' WHEN 9 THEN 'Septiembre'
    WHEN 10 THEN 'Octubre' WHEN 11 THEN 'Noviembre' WHEN 12 THEN 'Diciembre'
  END as mes_nombre,
  registros,
  promedio_m, promedio_cm,
  minimo_m, maximo_m,
  p10_m, p25_m, p50_m, p75_m, p90_m
FROM percentiles
ORDER BY mes;`;
}

// Analysis 2: Exceedance Frequency
else if (analysisType === 'exceedance_frequency') {
  query = `
WITH stats AS (
  SELECT 
    water_level_m,
    water_level_cm,
    COUNT(*) OVER () as total
  FROM water_level_measurements 
  WHERE station_id = '${stationId}'
    AND parameter = 'NivelMedioDiario'
    AND measurement_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '${years} years'
),
percentiles AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.90) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY water_level_m)::numeric, 3) as nivel_p90,
    ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY water_level_m)::numeric, 3) as nivel_p75,
    ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.50) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY water_level_m)::numeric, 3) as nivel_p50,
    ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY water_level_m)::numeric, 3) as nivel_p25,
    ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.10) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY water_level_m)::numeric, 3) as nivel_p10
  FROM stats
),
exceedance AS (
  SELECT 
    90 as prob_excedencia,
    nivel_p90 as nivel_m,
    ROUND((nivel_p90 * 100)::numeric, 1) as nivel_cm,
    'Minimo' as clasificacion
  FROM percentiles
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 75, nivel_p75, ROUND((nivel_p75 * 100)::numeric, 1), 'Bajo' FROM percentiles
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 50, nivel_p50, ROUND((nivel_p50 * 100)::numeric, 1), 'Normal' FROM percentiles
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 25, nivel_p25, ROUND((nivel_p25 * 100)::numeric, 1), 'Alto' FROM percentiles
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 10, nivel_p10, ROUND((nivel_p10 * 100)::numeric, 1), 'Maximo' FROM percentiles
)
SELECT * FROM exceedance ORDER BY prob_excedencia DESC;`;
}

// Analysis 3: Duration Curve
else if (analysisType === 'duration_curve') {
  query = `
WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    water_level_m,
    water_level_cm,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY water_level_m DESC) as rank,
    COUNT(*) OVER () as total
  FROM water_level_measurements 
  WHERE station_id = '${stationId}'
    AND parameter = 'NivelMedioDiario'
    AND measurement_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '${years} years'
),
duration_points AS (
  SELECT 
    water_level_m,
    water_level_cm,
    ROUND((rank::float / total * 100)::numeric, 2) as duracion_pct,
    ROUND((rank::float / total * 365)::numeric, 1) as dias_por_año
  FROM ranked
  WHERE rank IN (
    1,
    ROUND(total * 0.05)::int,
    ROUND(total * 0.10)::int,
    ROUND(total * 0.25)::int,
    ROUND(total * 0.50)::int,
    ROUND(total * 0.75)::int,
    ROUND(total * 0.90)::int,
    ROUND(total * 0.95)::int,
    total
  )
)
SELECT 
  duracion_pct as duracion_percentil,
  ROUND(water_level_m::numeric, 3) as nivel_m,
  water_level_cm as nivel_cm,
  dias_por_año,
  CASE 
    WHEN duracion_pct >= 90 THEN 'Muy Frecuente'
    WHEN duracion_pct >= 75 THEN 'Frecuente'
    WHEN duracion_pct >= 50 THEN 'Moderado'
    WHEN duracion_pct >= 25 THEN 'Poco Frecuente'
    ELSE 'Raro'
  END as clasificacion
FROM duration_points
ORDER BY duracion_pct DESC;`;
}

// Simple query
else {
  query = `
SELECT 
  measurement_date::date as fecha,
  ROUND(water_level_m::numeric, 3) as nivel_m,
  water_level_cm as nivel_cm
FROM water_level_measurements 
WHERE station_id = '${stationId}'
  AND parameter = 'NivelMedioDiario'
ORDER BY measurement_date DESC
LIMIT 50;`;
}

return [{
  json: {
    query: query,
    analysis_type: analysisType,
    station_name: stationName,
    station_id: stationId
  }
}];
